text:
BUPATI ENREKANG
MEMUTUSKAN :
Menetapkan : PERATURAN DAERAH TENTANG PERLINDUNGAN PEREMPUAN DAN ANAK.
translated_text:
REGENT OF ENREKANG
DECIDES :
To Establish : REGIONAL REGULATION CONCERNING THE PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN.

text:
BAB I
KETENTUAN UMUM
Pasal 1
Dalam Peraturan Daerah ini yang dimaksud dengan:
1. Daerah adalah Kabupaten Enrekang.
2. Pemerintah Daerah adalah Pemerintah Kabupaten Enrekang.
3. Bupati adalah Bupati Enrekang.
4. Perangkat Daerah, yang selanjutnya disingkat PD adalah Organisasi Perangkat Daerah di lingkungan Pemerintah Daerah.
5. Perempuan adalah seseorang yang berjenis kelamin Perempuan.
6. Anak adalah seseorang yang belum berusia 18 (delapan belas) tahun termasuk anak yang masih dalam kandungan.
7. Perlindungan Perempuan adalah segala upaya yang dilakukan oleh keluarga, pemerintah daerah dan lainnya yang ditujukan kepada perempuan untuk menjamin terpenuhinya hak perempuan sebagai bentuk penghormatan terhadap hak asasi manusia.
8. Perlindungan Anak adalah segala kegiatan untuk menjamin dan melindungi anak dan hak-haknya agar dapat hidup, tumbuh, berkembang dan berpartisipasi, secara optimal sesuai dengan harkat dan martabat kemanusiaan dan mendapat perlindungan dari kekerasan dan diskriminasi.
9. Perlindungan Khusus adalah perlindungan yang diberikan kepada Perempuan dan Anak yang berhadapan dengan hukum, eksploitasi ekonomi dan seksual, diperdagangkan, menjadi korban penyalahgunaan narkotika, alkohol, psikotropika dan zat adiktif lainnya (Napza), korban penculikan, penjualan, korban kekerasan, disabilitas, korban perlakuan salah dan/atau penelantaran.
10. Pencegahan adalah upaya langsung yang dilakukan Pemerintah Daerah bersama masyarakat dan Orang Tua dan/atau keluarga serta pihak swasta untuk mencegah terjadinya pelanggaran hak perempuan dan anak.
11. Pemberdayaan Perempuan adalah setiap upaya meningkatkan kemampuan fisik, mental, spiritual, sosial, pengetahuan, dan keterampilan agar perempuan siap didayagunakan sesuai dengan kemampuan masing-masing.
12. Diskriminasi adalah setiap pembedaan, pelecehan atau pengucilan yang langsung ataupun tak langsung yang didasarkan pada pembedaan manusia atas dasar agama, suku, ras, etnik kelompok, golongan status sosial, sosial ekonomi, jenis kelamin, bahasa, keyakinan politik yang berakibat pengurangan penyimpangan atau penghapusan pengakuan, pelaksanaan atau penggunaan hak azasi manusia dan kebebasan dasar dalam kehidupan baik individual maupun kolektif dalam bidang politik, ekonomi, hukum, sosial, budaya dan aspek kehidupan lainnya.
13. Kekerasan adalah setiap perbuatan yang berakibat atau dapat mengakibatkan kesengsaraan atau penderitaan baik fisik, seksual, ekonomi, sosial, psikis terhadap korban.
14. Kekerasan terhadap perempuan adalah setiap tindakan berdasarkan perbedaan jenis kelamin yang berakibat atau mungkin berakibat kesengsaraan atau penderitaan perempuan secara fisik, seksual, ekonomi, sosial, psikis termasuk ancaman tindakan tertentu, pemaksaan atau perampasan kemerdekaan secara sewenang-wenang, baik yang terjadi di depan umum atau kehidupan pribadi.
15. Kekerasan terhadap anak adalah setiap tindakan yang berakibat kesengsaraan atau penderitaan terhadap anak secara fisik, seksual, ekonomi, sosial, psikis termasuk ancaman tindakan tertentu, pemaksaan atau perampasan kemerdekaan.
16. Kekerasan dalam Rumah Tangga adalah setiap perbuatan terhadap seseorang terutama perempuan, yang berakibat timbulnya kesengsaraan atau penderitaan secara fisik, seksual, psikologis, dan/atau penelantaran rumah tangga termasuk ancaman untuk melakukan perbuatan, pemaksaan, atau perampasan kemerdekaan secara melawan hukum dalam lingkup rumah tangga.
17. Perdagangan (trafficking) perempuan dan anak, yang selanjutnya disebut trafficking adalah tindakan perekrutan, pengangkutan, penampungan, pengiriman, pemindahan, atau penerimaan perempuan dan/atau anak dengan ancaman kekerasan, penggunaan kekerasan, penculikan, penyekapan pemalsuan, penipuan, penyalahgunaan kekuasaan atau posisi rentan, penjeratan utang atau memberi bayaran atau manfaat, sehingga memperoleh persetujuan dari orang yang memegang kendali atas orang lain tersebut, baik yang dilakukan di dalam negara maupun antar negara, untuk tujuan eksploitasi atau mengakitbatkan orang terekploitasi.
18. Eksploitasi adalah tindakan dengan atau tanpa persetujuan korban yang meliputi tetapi tidak terbatas pada pelacuran, kerja atau pelayanan paksa, perbudakan atau praktik serupa perbudakan, penindasan, pemerasan, pemanfaatan fisik, seksual, organ reproduksi dan/atau jaringan tubuh atau memanfaatkan tenaga atau kemampuan seseorang oleh pihak lain untuk mendapatkan keuntungan baik materiil maupun immaterial.
19. Penyandang Disabilitas adalah setiap orang yang mengalami keterbatasan fisik, intelektual, mental dan/atau sensorik dalam jangka waktu lama yang dalam berinteraksi dengan lingkungan dapat mengalami hambatan dan kesulitan untuk berpartisipasi secara penuh dan efektif dengan warga negara lainnya berdasarkan kesamaan hak.
20. Pelayanan adalah tindakan yang dilakukan sesegera mungkin kepada korban ketika melihat, mendengar dan/atau mengetahui akan, sedang atau telah terjadinya kekerasan terhadap korban.
21. Korban adalah perempuan dan anak yang mengalami dan/atau menderita baik langsung maupun tidak langsung sebagai akibat dari kekerasan.
22. Forum Anak adalah Wadah Partisipasi anak yang dibentuk dengan tujuan memfasilitasi keterlibatan anak dalam proses pengambilan keputusan dan menikmati perubahan yang berkenaan dengan hidup mereka baik secara langsung maupun tidak langsung yang dilaksanakan dengan persetujuan dan kemauan semua anak berdasarkan kesadaran dan pemahaman, sesuai dengan usia dan tingkat kematangan berfikir.
23. Kabupaten, Kecamatan, dan Desa Layak Anak adalah Kabupaten, Kecamatan, dan Desa yang mempunyai sistem pembangunan yang berbasis hak anak melalui pengintegrasian komitmen dan sumber daya pemerintah, masyarakat dan dunia usaha yang terencana secara menyeluruh dan berkelanjutan dalam kebijakan, program dan kegiatan untuk menjamin terpenuhinya hak anak.
24. Rumah aman adalah sebuah tempat bernaung sementara yang bertujuan untuk memberikan perlindungan dan rasa aman kepada korban kekerasan.
25. Rumah singgah adalah wadah pembinaan atau pelayanan kesejahteraan anak jalanan yang melaksanakan kegiatan pendampingan/bimbingan sosial, pemeliharaan, perawatan, pendidikan dan kesehatan, bimbingan keterampilan guna menjamin agar anak tidak melakukan aktifitas di jalanan sehingga dapat tumbuh kembang secara wajar.
26. Orang tua adalah ayah dan/atau ibu kandung, atau ayah dan/atau ibu angkat.
translated_text:
CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS
Article 1
In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:
1. Region is Enrekang Regency.
2. Regional Government is the Government of Enrekang Regency.
3. Regent is the Regent of Enrekang.
4. Regional Apparatus, hereinafter abbreviated as PD is the Regional Apparatus Organization within the Regional Government.
5. Woman is a person who is female in gender.
6. Child is a person who has not yet reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years including a child still in the womb.
7. Protection of Women is all efforts made by the family, regional government and others directed towards women to ensure the fulfillment of women's rights as a form of respect for human rights.
8. Protection of Children is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
9. Special Protection is protection given to Women and Children in conflict with the law, economic and sexual exploitation, being trafficked, becoming victims of narcotics abuse, alcohol, psychotropic substances and other addictive substances (Napza), victims of kidnapping, sale, victims of violence, persons with disabilities, victims of maltreatment and/or neglect.
10. Prevention is direct efforts carried out by the Regional Government together with the community and Parents and/or families as well as private parties to prevent violations of the rights of women and children.
11. Women's Empowerment is every effort to improve physical, mental, spiritual, social abilities, knowledge, and skills so that women are ready to be utilized according to their respective abilities.
12. Discrimination is any distinction, harassment or exclusion, whether direct or indirect, based on human differentiation on the basis of religion, ethnicity, race, ethnic group, class, social status, socio-economic status, gender, language, political beliefs that results in the reduction, deviation or elimination of recognition, implementation or use of human rights and fundamental freedoms in life both individually and collectively in the political, economic, legal, social, cultural and other aspects of life.
13. Violence is any act that results in or may result in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, economic, social, psychological to the victim.
14. Violence against women is any act based on gender differences that results in or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually, economically, socially, psychologically including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or private life.
15. Violence against children is any act that results in misery or suffering to children physically, sexually, economically, socially, psychologically including threats of certain actions, coercion or deprivation of liberty.
16. Domestic Violence is any act against a person, especially women, that results in misery or suffering physically, sexually, psychologically, and/or household neglect including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of liberty within the household sphere.
17. Trafficking of women and children, hereinafter referred to as trafficking is the act of recruitment, transportation, harboring, sending, transfer, or receipt of women and/or children by threat of violence, use of violence, kidnapping, confinement, falsification, fraud, abuse of power or position of vulnerability, debt bondage or giving payment or benefits, so as to obtain consent from the person holding control over that other person, whether conducted within the country or between countries, for the purpose of exploitation or resulting in the person being exploited.
18. Exploitation is an act with or without the consent of the victim which includes but is not limited to prostitution, forced labor or services, slavery or practices similar to slavery, oppression, extortion, utilization of physical, sexual, reproductive organs and/or body tissues or utilizing the labor or ability of a person by another party to obtain benefits both material and immaterial.
19. Person with Disability is every person who experiences physical, intellectual, mental and/or sensory limitations in the long term who in interacting with the environment may experience obstacles and difficulties to participate fully and effectively with other citizens based on equal rights.
20. Service is action taken as soon as possible to the victim when seeing, hearing and/or knowing that violence against the victim will, is or has occurred.
21. Victim is a woman and child who experiences and/or suffers either directly or indirectly as a result of violence.
22. Children's Forum is a Children's Participation Forum formed with the aim of facilitating children's involvement in decision-making processes and enjoying changes relating to their lives either directly or indirectly which is carried out with the consent and will of all children based on awareness and understanding, in accordance with age and level of thinking maturity.
23. Child-Friendly Regency, Sub-district, and Village is a Regency, Sub-district, and Village that has a development system based on children's rights through the integration of government commitment and resources, community and business world that is planned comprehensively and sustainably in policies, programs and activities to ensure the fulfillment of children's rights.
24. Safe house is a temporary shelter that aims to provide protection and a sense of security to victims of violence.
25. Halfway house is a forum for guidance or welfare services for street children that carries out social assistance/guidance activities, maintenance, care, education and health, skills guidance in order to ensure that children do not carry out activities on the streets so that they can grow and develop normally.
26. Parents are biological father and/or mother, or adoptive father and/or mother.
qa_issues: Meaning drift in item 9: 'disability' should refer to persons with disabilities (disabilitas), not the abstract condition 'disability'.
Minor meaning drift/terminology in item 25: 'Rumah singgah' is a 'halfway house/transit shelter' for street children; 'Shelter house' is inaccurate/unnatural and may mislead downstream use.
Scrambled/incorrect list lettering: the original has two items labeled "e"; the last item should be "f" to preserve the intended sequence and avoid ambiguity.
Meaning drift/terminology: "Trafficking" should be translated as "trafficking in persons" (human trafficking) and not left as a capitalized English loanword.

Meaning drift/grammar: item (c) should clearly list forms of violence (physical, psychological, sexual) rather than "physical, psychological, sexual violence" which can read as a single combined term.
List marker error: item 'l.' in the original is mistranslated as '1.' (number one), disrupting the lettered list sequence.

text:
BAB IV
KEWAJIBAN DAN TANGGUNG JAWAB PEMERINTAH DAERAH, MASYARAKAT, ORANG TUA/WALI DAN/ ATAU KELUARGA
translated_text:
CHAPTER IV
OBLIGATIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES OF LOCAL GOVERNMENT, COMMUNITY, PARENTS/GUARDIANS AND/OR FAMILY

text:
Bagian kesatu
Pemerintah Daerah
translated_text:
First Part
Regional Government

qa_issues: Meaning drift/terminology: "PD" is left untranslated/undefined; should be rendered consistently as the relevant implementing Regional Apparatus/Local Government Work Unit (Perangkat Daerah) rather than the ambiguous acronym.

text:
Pasal 8
(1) Dalam melaksanakan kewajiban dan tanggung jawab sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 7 ayat (1), Pemerintah Daerah menetapkan program dan kegiatan perlindungan perempuan dan anak dengan Rencana Aksi Daerah sebagai dasar bagi PD dalam melaksanakan perlindungan perempuan dan anak sesuai dengan tugas dan fungsinya.
(2) Rencana Aksi Daerah sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) diatur dengan Peraturan Bupati.
translated_text:
Article 8
(1) In carrying out the obligations and responsibilities as referred to in Article 7 paragraph (1), the Regional Government establishes programs and activities for the protection of women and children, with a Regional Action Plan as the basis for the Regional Apparatus (PD) in implementing the protection of women and children in accordance with their duties and functions.
(2) The Regional Action Plan as referred to in paragraph (1) is regulated by a Regent Regulation.
qa_issues: Meaning drift/terminology: "Peraturan Bupati" should be translated as "Regent Regulation" or "Regulation of the Regent"; current "Regent Regulation" is acceptable, but "is regulated by" is inaccurate—should be "is stipulated/regulated by a Regent Regulation" to reflect 'diatur dengan' (regulated by means of).

Meaning drift/ambiguity: "PD" is left untranslated/undefined; should be rendered consistently as "Regional Apparatus (PD)" or "Regional Government Agencies (PD)" to preserve meaning that it refers to local government apparatus, not a generic acronym.

text:
Bagian Kedua
Masyarakat
translated_text:
Second Part
Society

text:
Pasal 9
Kewajiban dan tanggung jawab masyarakat dalam upaya perlindungan terhadap perempuan dan anak :
a. berpartisipasi dalam pencegahan dan memberikan dukungan terhadap pengembangan program pencegahan terjadinya pelanggaran terhadap hak perempuan dan anak;
b. memberikan informasi dan/atau melaporkan terjadinya pelanggaran hak perempuan dan anak kepada pihak yang berwenang; dan
c. mengawasi proses penegakan hukum terhadap kasus pelanggaran hak perempuan dan anak.
translated_text:
Article 9
Obligations and responsibilities of the community in efforts to protect women and children:
a. participate in prevention and provide support for the development of programs to prevent violations of the rights of women and children;
b. provide information and/or report violations of the rights of women and children to the competent authorities; and
c. monitor the law enforcement process regarding cases of violations of the rights of women and children.

qa_issues: Meaning drift/unnatural rendering in item (1)(e): "prevent marriage at child age" should reflect "prevent the occurrence of marriage at a child's age" (i.e., child marriage).

text:
Bagian Ketiga
Orang tua/Wali dan/atau Keluarga
translated_text:
Third Part
Parents/Guardians and/or Family

text:
Pasal 11
Keluarga dalam upaya perlindungan hak perempuan berkewajiban dan bertanggung jawab :
a. melindungi perempuan dari konflik dan kekerasan dalam rumah tangga yang merendahkan martabat perempuan;
b. memberikan kesempatan yang sama kepada perempuan mengembangkan diri di bidang pendidikan, sosial, ekonomi, politik dan budaya; dan
c. mencegah terjadinya pelanggaran terhadap hak perempuan dalam rumah tangga.
translated_text:
Article 11
The family, in efforts to protect women's rights, has the obligation and responsibility to:
a. protect women from conflict and violence in the household that degrades the dignity of women;
b. provide equal opportunities to women to develop themselves in the fields of education, social affairs, economics, politics, and culture; and
c. prevent the occurrence of violations of women's rights in the household.
qa_issues: Meaning drift/unnatural rendering in item (b): "in the fields of education, social, economic, political and cultural" omits the noun for "social" and "cultural"; should reflect "bidang pendidikan, sosial, ekonomi, politik dan budaya" as "education, social, economic, political, and cultural fields/areas".

text:
Bagian kedua
Masyarakat
translated_text:
Part Two
Society

qa_issues: Meaning drift/unnatural legal term: "marriage at the age of Children" should reflect "perkawinan pada usia Anak" as "child marriage" or "marriage at a child's age" (marriage when the person is a child).

text:
Bagian ketiga Orang tua/wali dan/atau Keluarga
Pasal 14
Orang tua/wali, dan/atau keluarga melakukan pencegahan terhadap pelanggaran hak perempuan dan anak dengan cara:
a. melindungi perempuan dan anak dari berbagai tindak pelanggaran hak perempuan dan anak dalam rumah tangga.
b. mengawasi perempuan dan anak dalam beraktivitas di dalam ataupun di luar rumah; dan
c. memberikan peluang bagi perempuan dan anak berdialog menyampaikan pendapat secara demokratis.
translated_text:
Part Three Parents/Guardians and/or Family
Article 14
Parents/guardians, and/or family shall undertake prevention against violations of the rights of women and children by means of:
a. protecting women and children from various acts of violation of the rights of women and children within the household.
b. supervising women and children in their activities inside or outside the home; and
c. providing opportunities for women and children to engage in dialogue and express their opinions democratically.

text:
BAB VI PENYELENGGARAAN PERLINDUNGAN PEREMPUAN DAN ANAK
Bagian Kesatu Perlindungan Perempuan
Paragraf 1
Kesehatan
translated_text:
CHAPTER VI IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN
Part One Protection of Women
Subparagraph 1
Health

text:
Pasal 15
(1) Pemerintah Daerah menyediakan fasilitas dan menyelenggarakan upaya kesehatan yang komprehensif bagi perempuan agar memperoleh derajat kesehatan yang optimal.
(2) Penyediaan fasilitas dan penyelenggaraan upaya kesehatan secara komprehensif sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) di dukung oleh peran serta masyarakat.
translated_text:
Article 15
(1) Regional Governments provide facilities and organize comprehensive health efforts for women in order to obtain optimal health status.
(2) The provision of facilities and organization of comprehensive health efforts as referred to in paragraph (1) is supported by community participation.

text:
Paragraf 2
Pendidikan
translated_text:
Paragraph 2
Education

text:
Pasal 16
(1) Pemerintah Daerah menjamin terselenggaranya pendidikan informal bagi perempuan putus sekolah.
(2) Penyelenggaraan pendidikan informal sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) didukung oleh peran serta masyarakat dan dunia usaha.
translated_text:
Article 16
(1) Regional Governments guarantee the implementation of informal education for women who have dropped out of school.
(2) The implementation of informal education as referred to in paragraph (1) is supported by the participation of the community and the business sector.

text:
Paragraf 3 Pemberdayaan
(1) Pemerintah Daerah menjamin terselenggaranya pemberdayaan bagi perempuan.
(2) Penyelenggaraan pemberdayaan perempuan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) didukung oleh peran serta masyarakat dan dunia usaha.
translated_text:
Paragraph 3 Empowerment
(1) The Regional Government guarantees the implementation of empowerment for women.
(2) The implementation of women's empowerment as referred to in paragraph (1) is supported by the participation of the community and the business sector.

text:
Paragraf 4
Pekerjaan
translated_text:
Paragraph 4
Work
qa_issues: Meaning drift: "Pekerjaan" means "Work"/"Occupation", not "Employment" in this heading context.

text:
Pasal 18
(1) Perlindungan terhadap perempuan pekerja meliputi:
a. mendapatkan tempat ruang untuk menyusui; dan
b. mendapatkan fasilitas untuk pengasuhan anak.
(2) Fasilitas pengasuhan anak usia dini sebagaimana dimaksud ayat (1) huruf b yang dikelola oleh masyarakat harus mendapat rekomendasi Pemerintah Daerah.
translated_text:
Article 18
(1) Protection for female workers includes:
a. obtaining a space for breastfeeding; and
b. obtaining childcare facilities.
(2) Early childhood care facilities as referred to in paragraph (1) letter b that are managed by the community must obtain a recommendation from the Regional Government.

text:
Paragraf 5
Ekonomi Mikro
translated_text:
Paragraph 5
Micro Economy

text:
Pasal 19
Perlindungan Ekonomi Mikro Perempuan meliputi :
a. mendapatkan kesempatan melakukan kegiatan usaha di lingkungan rumah tangga; dan
b. mendapatkan fasilitas pemberdayaan ekonomi khususnya bagi perempuan kepala keluarga.
translated_text:
Article 19
Protection of Women's Micro Economy includes:
a. obtaining opportunities to conduct business activities in the household environment; and
b. obtaining economic empowerment facilities especially for women heads of households.

text:
Paragraf 6
Perkawinan
translated_text:
Paragraph 6
Marriage

text:
Pasal 20
(1) Seorang perempuan selama dalam ikatan perkawinan mempunyai hak dan tanggung jawab yang sama dengan suaminya atas semua hal yang berkenaan dengan kehidupan perkawinannya, hubungan dengan anak-anaknya dan hak pemilikan serta pengelolaan harta bersama.
(2) Setelah putusan hakim mengenai perceraian, seorang perempuan mempunyai hak dan tanggung jawab yang sama dengan mantan suaminya atas semua hal yang berkenaan dengan anak-anaknya, dengan memperhatikan kepentingan terbaik bagi anak.
(3) Setelah putusan hakim mengenai perceraian, seorang perempuan mempunyai hak yang sama dengan mantan suaminya atas semua hal yang berkenaan dengan harta bersama tanpa mengurangi hak anak, sesuai dengan ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan.
translated_text:
Article 20
(1) A woman during the marriage bond has the same rights and responsibilities as her husband over all matters concerning their marital life, relationship with their children and ownership rights as well as management of joint property.
(2) After a court decision regarding divorce, a woman has the same rights and responsibilities as her former husband over all matters concerning their children, taking into account the best interests of the child.
(3) After a court decision regarding divorce, a woman has the same rights as her former husband over all matters concerning joint property without diminishing the rights of the child, in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

text:
Bagian Kedua Perlindungan Anak
Paragraf 1
Kesehatan
translated_text:
Part Two
Child Protection
Paragraph 1
Health
qa_issues: Meaning drift/unnatural rendering of headings: missing definite article and proper heading structure; 'Bagian Kedua Perlindungan Anak' should be rendered as 'Part Two Child Protection' (or 'Protection of Children') rather than 'Second Part Protection of Children'.

text:
Pasal 21
(1) Pemerintah Daerah menyediakan fasilitas dan menyelengarakan upaya kesehatan yang komprehensif bagi anak agar memperoleh derajat kesehatan yang optimal mulai dari dalam kandungan.
(2) Penyediaan fasilitas dan penyelenggaraan upaya kesehatan secara komprehensif sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) di dukung oleh peran serta masyarakat.
(3) Upaya kesehatan yang komprehensif sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) meliputi upaya promotif, preventif, kuratif, dan rehabilitatif baik untuk kesehatan dasar maupun rujukan.
(4) Pemerintah Daerah memfasilitasi dan memberikan bantuan gizi atau makanan tambahan untuk peningkatan kesehatan anak dan keluarga miskin.
(5) Upaya kesehatan yang komprehensif sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dilakukan secara bertahap sesuai dengan kemampuan keuangan daerah.
translated_text:
Article 21
(1) Regional Government provides facilities and organizes comprehensive health efforts for children to obtain optimal health status starting from the womb.
(2) The provision of facilities and organization of comprehensive health efforts as referred to in paragraph (1) is supported by community participation.
(3) Comprehensive health efforts as referred to in paragraph (1) include promotive, preventive, curative, and rehabilitative efforts both for basic health and referral.
(4) Regional Government facilitates and provides nutritional assistance or supplementary food for health improvement of children and poor families.
(5) Comprehensive health efforts as referred to in paragraph (1) are carried out in stages according to regional financial capacity.

text:
Pasal 22
Keluarga dan orang tua bertanggung jawab menjaga dan merawat anak sejak dalam kandungan.
translated_text:
Article 22
The family and parents are responsible for protecting and caring for the child from the womb.

text:
Pasal 23
Pemerintah Daerah, dunia usaha, masyarakat, keluarga dan orang tua mengusahakan agar anak yang lahir terhindar dari penyakit.
translated_text:
Article 23
Regional Government, business sector, community, family and parents shall endeavor to ensure that children who are born are protected from disease.

text:
Paragraf 2
Pendidikan
translated_text:
Paragraph 2
Education

text:
Pasal 24
(1) Pemerintah Daerah menjamin terselenggaranya program wajib belajar 9 (Sembilan) tahun untuk semua anak.
(2) Penyelenggaraan program wajib belajar sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) didukung oleh peran serta masyarakat dan dunia usaha.
(3) Orang tua dan keluarga memberikan kesempatan seluasnya kepada anak sesuai kemampuan anak untuk memperoleh pendidikan.
(4) Setiap penyelenggara satuan pendidikan dilarang mengeluarkan anak dari lembaga pendidikan tanpa alasan yang jelas dan melalui prosedur sesuai dengan peraturan perundang-undangan.
translated_text:
Article 24
(1) The Regional Government guarantees the implementation of a 9 (nine) year compulsory education program for all children.
(2) The implementation of the compulsory education program as referred to in paragraph (1) is supported by the participation of the community and the business sector.
(3) Parents and families provide the widest opportunity to children according to the child's ability to obtain education.
(4) Every organizer of an education unit is prohibited from expelling children from educational institutions without clear reasons and through procedures in accordance with statutory regulations.

text:
Pasal 25
Anak yang berhadapan dengan hukum, anak yang mengalami kehamilan di luar pernikahan dan anak korban penularan HIV/AIDS dilindungi haknya guna memperoleh pendidikan.
translated_text:
Article 25
Children in conflict with the law, children who experience pregnancy outside of marriage and children who are victims of HIV/AIDS transmission are protected in their rights to obtain education.

text:
Pasal 26
Bagi anak berusia 7 (tujuh) sampai dengan kurang dari 15 (lima belas) tahun yang belum menyelesaikan pendidikan formalnya dapat menempuh pendidikan melalui satuan pendidikan informal:
a. kelompok belajar paket A setara Sekolah Dasar dan Madrasah Ibtidaiyah; atau
b. kelompok belajar paket B setara Sekolah Menengah Pertama dan Madrasah Tsanawiyah;
translated_text:
Article 26
Children aged 7 (seven) to less than 15 (fifteen) years who have not completed their formal education may pursue education through informal education units:
a. Package A study group equivalent to Elementary School and Madrasah Ibtidaiyah; or
b. Package B study group equivalent to Junior High School and Madrasah Tsanawiyah;
qa_issues: Meaning drift/grammar: missing subject linkage; should clearly state that such children may pursue education through informal education units (not 'For children ... may').

text:
Pasal 27
(1) Pemerintah Daerah dapat memberikan beasiswa dan/atau bantuan pendidikan bagi anak dari keluarga miskin.
(2) Penyelenggaraan program beasiswa dan/atau bantuan pendidikan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) didukung oleh peran serta masyarakat dan organisasi kemasyarakatan.
translated_text:
Article 27
(1) Regional Governments may provide scholarships and/or educational assistance for children from poor families.
(2) The implementation of scholarship programs and/or educational assistance as referred to in paragraph (1) is supported by the participation of the community and community organizations.

text:
Pasal 28
Pemerintah wajib melindungi anak dalam lingkungan sekolah dari tindakan kekerasan yang dilakukan oleh guru, pengelola sekolah atau teman sekolah.
translated_text:
Article 28
The Government is obligated to protect children in the school environment from acts of violence committed by teachers, school administrators or schoolmates.

text:
Pasal 29
(1) Pemerintah daerah wajib mengembangkan model sekolah ramah anak.
(2) Sekolah ramah anak sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) merupakan upaya bersama Pemerintah Daerah dengan pengelola sekolah untuk menciptakan lingkungan yang aman dan nyaman bagi anak di sekolah.
(3) Anak yang berasal dari keluarga miskin dan/atau penyandang disabilitas berhak mendapat perlakuan yang sama dan adil untuk memperoleh layanan dan bimbingan di sekolah.
translated_text:
Article 29
(1) Regional governments are obligated to develop child-friendly school models.
(2) Child-friendly schools as referred to in paragraph (1) constitute a joint effort between Regional Governments and school administrators to create a safe and comfortable environment for children at school.
(3) Children from poor families and/or children with disabilities have the right to equal and fair treatment to obtain services and guidance at school.
qa_issues: Meaning drift in paragraph (3): 'penyandang disabilitas' refers to children with disabilities, not 'persons with disabilities' generally.

text:
Pasal 30
(1) Penyelenggara pendidikan melengkapi sekolah yang dipimpinanya dengan fasilitas responsive gender.
(2) Fasilitas responsive gender sebagaimana yang dimaksud pada ayat (1) meliputi :
a. toilet/WC laki-laki dan perempuan dipisahkan serta antara guru dan murid;
b. meja guru dan meja siswa dilengkapi penutup.
(3) Pelaksanaan ketentuan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dan ayat (2) dilaksanakan sesuai kemampuan keuangan daerah.
translated_text:
Article 30
(1) Education providers shall equip the schools under their leadership with gender-responsive facilities.
(2) Gender-responsive facilities as referred to in paragraph (1) include:
a. toilets/WCs for men and women are separated as well as between teachers and students;
b. teacher desks and student desks are equipped with covers.
(3) Implementation of the provisions as referred to in paragraph (1) and paragraph (2) shall be carried out in accordance with regional financial capacity.

text:
Paragraf 3
Ketenagakerjaan
translated_text:
Paragraph 3
Employment

text:
Pasal 31
(1) Setiap orang dilarang mempekerjakan dan melibatkan anak pada pekerjaan yang terburuk.
(2) Pekerjaan yang terburuk sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) meliputi :
a. pekerjaan dalam bentuk perbudakan atau sejenisnya;
b. pekerjaan yang memanfaatkan, menyediakan atau menawarkan anak untuk pelacuran, produksi pornografi, pertunjukan porno atau perjudiaan.
c. pekerjaan yang memanfaatkan, menyediakan, atau melibatkan anak untuk produksi dan perdagangan minuman keras, narkotika, psikotropika, dan zat adiktif lainnya; dan/atau
d. pekerjaan yang membahayakan kesehatan, keselamatan dan moral anak.
translated_text:
Article 31
(1) Every person is prohibited from employing and involving children in the worst forms of work.
(2) The worst forms of work as referred to in paragraph (1) include:
a. work in the form of slavery or similar practices;
b. work that exploits, provides or offers children for prostitution, pornography production, pornographic performances or gambling;
c. work that exploits, provides, or involves children for the production and trade of alcoholic beverages, narcotics, psychotropic substances, and other addictive substances; and/or
d. work that endangers the health, safety and morals of children.
qa_issues: Scrambled list/numbering structure: item (2) list uses inconsistent punctuation; item b ends with a period while other items use semicolons, and item c lacks the expected separator after b, risking mis-parsing of list items in downstream processing.

text:
Paragraf 4
Sosial
translated_text:
Paragraph 4
Social

text:
Pasal 32
(1) Pemerintah Daerah menyelenggarakan pemeliharaan anak terlantar.
(2) Pemeliharaan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dapat dilakukan oleh Organisasi Kemasyarakatan di bidang sosial.
translated_text:
Article 32
(1) The Local Government shall organize the care of neglected children.
(2) The care as referred to in paragraph (1) may be carried out by community organizations in the social field.
qa_issues: Meaning drift: "Pemerintah Daerah" should be singular (Local Government), not plural (Regional Governments).

Meaning drift/omission: "Organisasi Kemasyarakatan di bidang sosial" means community organizations in the social field; translation renders it as "Social Community Organizations" which is ambiguous and drops "in the social field".

text:
Pasal 33
(1) Pemerintah Daerah menyelenggarakan pelatihan keterampilan bagi anak jalanan dan anak terlantar.
(2) Pelatihan keterampilan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) diselenggarakan oleh PD sesuai dengan bidang tugas dan fungsinya masing-masing.
translated_text:
Article 33
(1) The Regional Government organizes skills training for street children and abandoned children.
(2) Skills training as referred to in paragraph (1) is organized by the Regional Government in accordance with their respective duties and functions.
qa_issues: Meaning drift/ambiguity: "PD" is left untranslated/undefined; in the original it refers to "Pemerintah Daerah" (Regional Government), so keeping "PD" can change or obscure the legal subject responsible.

text:
Pasal 34
(1) Pemerintah Daerah dapat menyediakan rumah singgah untuk membina anak jalanan dan panti sosial untuk anak terlantar.
(2) Rumah singgah sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dapat diselenggarakan bekerjasama dengan organisasi kemasyarakatan.
translated_text:
Article 34
(1) The Local Government may provide shelters to guide street children and social homes for neglected children.
(2) Shelters as referred to in paragraph (1) may be operated in cooperation with community organizations.
qa_issues: Meaning drift: "Pemerintah Daerah" should be singular (Local Government), not plural "Regional Governments".
Meaning drift: "panti sosial" is translated as "social institutions"; more accurate is "social homes"/"social shelters" (panti sosial).

text:
Pasal 35
Penyelenggaraan perlindungan perempuan dan anak dilaksanakan oleh PD lintas sektoral yang tugas dan fungsinya berkaitan dengan perlindungan perempuan dan anak.
translated_text:
Article 35
The implementation of protection for women and children shall be carried out by cross-sectoral Regional Apparatus whose duties and functions are related to the protection of women and children.

text:
BAB VII
PELAYANAN PEREMPUAN DAN ANAK KORBAN KEKERASAN
Bagian Kesatu
Umum
translated_text:
CHAPTER VII
SERVICES FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE
Part One
General

qa_issues: Meaning drift/unnatural rendering in item f: 'without charging fees from victims' should reflect 'without being charged any fees to the victim' (free of charge for the victim).

translated_text:
Article 38
(1) Complaints of acts of violence against women and children may be submitted by a complainant, which may be the victim, the family, the community, and/or community organizations in the field of the protection of women and children.
(2) The complainant as referred to in paragraph (1) may submit a complaint:
 a. directly;
 b. by telephone/short message service; or
 c. by letter/electronic mail.
qa_issues: Meaning drift/unnatural legal meaning: "reporters consisting of" misrenders "pelapor yang terdiri atas"; should be "a complainant, which may be" (victim, family, community, and/or relevant community organizations).

Meaning drift/typo in translation of "electronic mail": original has "elektroni mail" (intended "electronic mail"), but translation should reflect "electronic mail" while keeping the medium as "letter/electronic mail"; also ensure "by telephone/short message service" reads as a method of filing a complaint.
Meaning drift/term not translated: "P2TP2A" is an acronym for "Pusat Pelayanan Terpadu Pemberdayaan Perempuan dan Anak" and should be rendered in English (at least expanded) for legal clarity.

Meaning drift/abbreviation not preserved: "Satuan tugas PPA" should retain the PPA abbreviation as in the original (not expanded/altered), and should be translated as a "task force" with the abbreviation kept.

text:
Pasal 40
Ketentuan mengenai tata cara pengaduan sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 38 akan diatur dengan Peraturan Bupati
translated_text:
Article 40
Provisions regarding the procedure for complaints as referred to in Article 38 shall be regulated by a Regent's Regulation.
qa_issues: Meaning drift/unnatural legal term: "Regent Regulation" should be "Regent's Regulation" (Peraturan Bupati).

text:
Bagian ketiga
Pelayanan Kesehatan
translated_text:
Third Part
Health Services

text:
Pasal 41
(1) Pelayanan kesehatan sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 36 huruf b meliputi aspek promotif, preventif, kuratif dan rehabilitatif.
(2) Pelayanan kesehatan bagi perempuan dan anak korban kekerasan dilakukan secara komprehensif, dapat diakses 24 (dua puluh empat ) jam, berkualitas dan dilakukan sesuai dengan standar pelayanan kesehatan.
(3) Pelayanan kesehatan khusus untuk anak korban kekerasan harus mendahulukan kepentingan terbaik untuk anak.
(4) Perempuan dan anak korban kekerasan memiliki hak terhadap pelayanan kesehatan, meliputi:
a. pelayanan medis:
b. pelayanan medikolegal; dan
c. konseling psikososial.
(5) Upaya pelayanan kesehatan secara komprehensif sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (4) yang diperuntukkan bagi korban kekerasan, penculikan, penelantaran, tereksploitasi secara ekonomi, seksual dan perdagangan perempuan dan anak dijamin oleh Pemerintah Daerah.
(6) Upaya pelayanan kesehatan komprehensif sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dilakukan secara bertahap disesuaikan dengan kemampuan keuangan daerah.
translated_text:
Article 41
(1) Health services as referred to in Article 36 letter b include promotive, preventive, curative and rehabilitative aspects.
(2) Health services for women and children victims of violence shall be conducted comprehensively, accessible 24 (twenty four) hours, with quality and conducted in accordance with health service standards.
(3) Special health services for children victims of violence must prioritize the best interests of the child.
(4) Women and children victims of violence have the right to health services, including:
a. medical services;
b. medicolegal services; and
c. psychosocial counseling.
(5) Comprehensive efforts to provide health services as referred to in paragraph (4), intended for victims of violence, abduction, neglect, economic and sexual exploitation, and trafficking in women and children, are guaranteed by the Regional Government.
(6) Comprehensive health service efforts as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be conducted in stages adjusted to the regional financial capacity.
qa_issues: Meaning drift/awkward rendering in paragraph (5): list of victim categories is mistranslated/ungrounded ("economically exploited, sexually and trafficking") and should reflect "economically and sexually exploited, and trafficking in women and children".
Meaning drift in paragraph (5): "upaya pelayanan kesehatan" should be rendered as "efforts to provide health services" (not "health service efforts").

text:
Bagian keempat
Rehabilitasi Sosial
translated_text:
Fourth Part
Social Rehabilitation

text:
Pasal 42
(1) Pelayanan Rehabilitasi Sosial bagi Perempuan dan Anak Korban Kekerasan ditujukan untuk memulihkan dan mengembangkan kemampuan korban yang mengalami disfungsi sosial untuk dapat melaksanakan fungsi sosialnya dalam masyarakat secara wajar.
(2) Pelayanan Rehabilitasi Sosial sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) meliputi pelayanan konseling dan bimbingan rohani.
(3) Penyelenggaraan pelayanan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (2) diselenggarakan oleh:
a. PD yang mempunyai tugas dan fungsi di bidang sosial; dan
b. lembaga penanganan pelayanan.
translated_text:
Article 42
(1) Social Rehabilitation Services for Women and Children Victims of Violence are intended to restore and develop the abilities of victims who experience social dysfunction to be able to carry out their social functions in society properly.
(2) Social Rehabilitation Services as referred to in paragraph (1) include counseling services and spiritual guidance.
(3) The implementation of services as referred to in paragraph (2) is carried out by:
a. Regional Apparatus that has duties and functions in the social field; and
b. service handling institutions.

text:
Pasal 43
(1) Pelayanan konseling sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 42 ayat (2) bertujuan:
a. membantu korban mengenai permasalahan dan menemukan cara yang efektif untuk mengatasinya sendiri;
b. memberdayakan korban untuk menentukan masa depannya;
c. memberikan dukungan moral bagi korban dalam menghadapi proses yang dijalaniya; dan
d. membuat korban merasa diterima di lingkungan masyarakat.
(2) Pelayanan konseling dilakukan oleh petugas rehabilitasi sosial yang responsif gender, terdiri atas:
a. Konselor;
b. Psikolog; dan
c. Psik iater.
(3) Pelayanan konseling dilakukan di tempat yang menjamin rasa aman, nyaman dan kerahasiaan informasi dari korban.
(4) Tahapan pelayanan konseling meliputi:
a. konseling awal; dan
b. konseling lanjutan.
translated_text:
Article 43
(1) Counseling services as referred to in Article 42 paragraph (2) aim to:
a. assist victims regarding problems and find effective ways to overcome them independently;
b. empower victims to determine their future;
c. provide moral support for victims in facing the process they are undergoing; and
d. make victims feel accepted in the community environment.
(2) Counseling services are conducted by gender-responsive social rehabilitation officers, consisting of:
a. Counselors;
b. Psychologists; and
c. Psychiatrists.
(3) Counseling services are conducted in a place that guarantees a sense of security, comfort and confidentiality of the victim's information.
(4) Stages of counseling services include:
a. initial counseling; and
b. follow-up counseling.
qa_issues: Meaning drift in Article 43(3): "confidentiality of information from victims" should be "confidentiality of the victim's information" (kerahasiaan informasi dari korban).

text:
Pasal 44
(1) Pemerintah Daerah bertanggungjawab memfasilitasi ketersediaan rumah aman bagi perempuan dan anak korban kekerasan.
(2) Rumah aman bertujuan untuk melindungi perempuan dan anak korban kekerasan dari intimidasi pelaku dan pihak lain.
(3) Lokasi rumah aman sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) harus dirahasiakan.
(4) Kriteria perempuan dan anak korban kekerasan yang memerlukan rumah aman meliputi:
a. terancam jiwanya;
b. mendapatkan penolakan dari keluarga atau masyarakat;
c. memerlukan pelayanan intensif namun rumah tinggalnya relatif jauh; dan/atau
d.  terlantar jika tidak ditempatkan dalam rumah aman.
translated_text:
Article 44
(1) Regional Governments are responsible for facilitating the availability of safe houses for women and children victims of violence.
(2) Safe houses aim to protect women and children victims of violence from intimidation by perpetrators and other parties.
(3) The location of safe houses as referred to in paragraph (1) must be kept confidential.
(4) Criteria for women and children victims of violence who require safe houses include:
a. their life is threatened;
b. receiving rejection from family or community;
c. requiring intensive services but their residence is relatively far; and/or
d. abandoned if not placed in a safe house.

text:
Pasal 45
(1) Terhadap perempuan dan anak korban kekerasan diberikan bimbingan rohani yang ditujukan untuk pemulihan kejiwaan.
(2) Bimbingan rohani sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dilaksanakan berdasarkan prinsip:
a. tidak memaksakan agama dan keyakinan apapun; dan
b. menyerahkan putusan akhir ditangan korban/self determination (3) Bimbingan rohani dilakukan oleh petugas bimbingan rohani (4) Petugas bimbingan rohani sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (3) terdiri dari Konsultan Badan Penasehatan, Pembinaan dan Pelestarian Perkawinan (BP4), Petugas Kantor Urusan Agama (KUA), Ustad/Ulama, Pastor, Pendeta dan pemuka agama lainnya yang responsif gender.
translated_text:
Article 45
(1) Women and children victims of violence are provided with spiritual guidance aimed at psychological recovery.
(2) Spiritual guidance as referred to in paragraph (1) is implemented based on the principles of:
   a. not imposing any religion or belief; and
   b. leaving the final decision to the victim/self-determination.
(3) Spiritual guidance is conducted by spiritual guidance officers.
(4) Spiritual guidance officers as referred to in paragraph (3) consist of Consultants of the Advisory, Development and Preservation of Marriage Agency (BP4), Officers of the Office of Religious Affairs (KUA), Ustad/Ulama, Priests, Pastors, Ministers, and other religious leaders who are gender responsive.
qa_issues: Scrambled/merged numbering structure: paragraphs (3) and (4) are run into item (2)(b) without proper separation.

Minor meaning/terminology drift: 'putusan akhir ditangan korban' should be rendered as 'the final decision to the victim' (self-determination), not 'in the hands of the victim' merged with following text. Also 'Pendeta' should be 'Ministers' (or Protestant ministers), distinct from 'Pastor'.

text:
Bagian Kelima
Bantuan Hukum
translated_text:
Fifth Part
Legal Assistance

qa_issues: Meaning drift/terminology: "putusan sidang pengadilan" is the court decision/judgment, and "keputusan yang berkekuatan hukum tetap" is a final and binding decision (final legal force), better rendered explicitly to avoid ambiguity.

Meaning drift/terminology: "Berita Acara Pemeriksaan" is an Examination/Investigation Report (official minutes of examination), not "Official Investigation Report" as a fixed term; adjust to standard legal meaning.

text:
Bagian keenam
Pelayanan Pemulangan dan Reintegrasi Sosial
translated_text:
Sixth Part
Repatriation Services and Social Reintegration

text:
Pasal 47
(1) Pemulangan sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 36 huruf e ditujukan untuk mengembalikan perempuan dan anak korban kekerasan ke daerah asalnya.
(2) Pemulangan korban kekerasan perempuan dan anak disertai upaya reintegrasi sosial.
(3) Pemerintah Daerah melaksanakan pemulangan dan reintegrasi sosial perempuan dan anak korban kekerasan sesuai peraturan perundang-undangan.
translated_text:
Article 47
(1) Repatriation as referred to in Article 36 letter e is intended to return women and children victims of violence to their region of origin.
(2) Repatriation of women and children victims of violence is accompanied by social reintegration efforts.
(3) Regional Governments carry out repatriation and social reintegration of women and children victims of violence in accordance with laws and regulations.

text:
BAB VIII
KELEMBAGAAN
Pasal 48
(1) Penyelenggaraan Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak dilakukan oleh Pemerintah Daerah.
(2) Penyelenggaraan Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak oleh Pemerintah Daerah sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dilaksanakan oleh :
a. P2TP2A, UPT
b. LK3; dan
c. Satgas PPA.
translated_text:
CHAPTER VIII
INSTITUTIONAL FRAMEWORK
Article 48
(1) The Implementation of Protection of Women and Children is carried out by the Regional Government.
(2) The Implementation of Protection of Women and Children by the Regional Government as referred to in paragraph (1) is executed by:
a. P2TP2A, UPT
b. LK3; and
c. Satgas PPA.

text:
Bagian Kesatu
P2TP2A UPT PPA
Pasal 49
(1) Susunan keanggotaan P2TP2A sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 48 ayat (2) huruf a, ditetapkan dengan Keputusan Bupati.
(2) P2TP2A sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 48 ayat (2) huruf a, memfasilitasi pembentukan unit pada tingkat kecamatan sampai dengan desa/kelurahan.
(3) Pembentukan unit P2TP2A sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (2) pada tingkat kecamatan ditetapkan oleh Camat.
(4) Pembentukan unit P2TP2A sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (2) pada tingkat Desa ditetapkan dengan Keputusan Kepala Desa dan pada tingkat Kelurahan ditetapkan oleh Lurah.
translated_text:
Part One
P2TP2A UPT PPA
Article 49
(1) The membership composition of P2TP2A as referred to in Article 48 paragraph (2) letter a, shall be determined by a Regent’s Decree.
(2) P2TP2A as referred to in Article 48 paragraph (2) letter a, shall facilitate the establishment of units at the sub-district level down to the village/urban village level.
(3) The establishment of P2TP2A units as referred to in paragraph (2) at the sub-district level shall be determined by the Sub-district Head (Camat).
(4) The establishment of P2TP2A units as referred to in paragraph (2) at the Village level shall be determined by a Village Head’s Decree and at the Urban Village level shall be determined by the Head of Urban Village (Lurah).
qa_issues: Meaning drift/grammar: missing definite article in 'by Regent's Decree' (should be 'by a Regent's Decree' / 'by Regent Decree') and inconsistent rendering of official titles; clarify that determination is made through a Regent's Decree.

Meaning drift: 'Urban Village Head' is not the correct equivalent of 'Lurah' in this context; should be 'Head of Urban Village (Lurah)' or 'Lurah' to preserve the legal office. Also 'Sub-District Head' should align with 'Camat' (Sub-district Head/Camat).

text:
Pasal 51
(4) Pemerintah Daerah memfasilitasi terbentuknya Forum anak pada tingkat kabupaten, kecamatan, dan desa/kelurahan.
(5) Forum anak sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) merupakan representasi anak di Daerah, baik representasi domisili geografis anak, komponen kelompok sosial budaya anak, dan latar belakang pendidikan anak.
(6) Dalam setiap penyusunan kebijakan yang terkait dengan anak, Pemerintah Daerah harus memperhatikan dan mengakomodasi pendapat anak yang disampaikan melalui Forum anak.
(7) Pembentukan Forum anak sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) pada tingkat kabupaten ditetapkan dengan Keputusan Bupati.
(8) Pembentukan Forum anak sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) pada tingkat kecamatan ditetapkan oleh Camat.
(9) Pembentukan Forum anak sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) pada tingkat Desa ditetapkan dengan Keputusan Kepala Desa dan pada tingkat Kelurahan ditetapkan oleh Lurah.
translated_text:
Article 51
(4) The Regional Government facilitates the establishment of Children's Forums at the regency, sub-district, and village/urban village levels.
(5) The Children's Forum as referred to in paragraph (1) constitutes a representation of children in the Region, including representation of children's geographical domicile, components of children's socio-cultural groups, and children's educational backgrounds.
(6) In every formulation of policies related to children, the Regional Government must consider and accommodate the opinions of children conveyed through the Children's Forum.
(7) The establishment of the Children's Forum as referred to in paragraph (1) at the regency level shall be determined by a Regent Decree.
(8) The establishment of the Children's Forum as referred to in paragraph (1) at the sub-district level shall be determined by the Sub-District Head.
(9) The establishment of the Children's Forum as referred to in paragraph (1) at the village level shall be determined by a Village Head Decree and at the urban village level shall be determined by the Head of the Urban Village (Lurah).
qa_issues: Meaning drift/unnatural legal phrasing in (7) and (9): missing definite article and possessive construction; should be 'by a Regent Decree'/'by a Village Head Decree' rather than 'by Regent's Decree'/'Village Head's Decree' to reflect 'dengan Keputusan Bupati/Kepala Desa'.
Minor meaning/term precision: 'urban village head' should correspond to 'Lurah' (Head of Kelurahan), and 'sub-district head' to 'Camat'; capitalization inconsistency for 'village' in (9).

(1) Evaluation of the implementation of policies, programs and activities for the Protection of Women and Children shall be conducted at the end of each fiscal year or when necessary according to needs.
(2) The results of the evaluation of the implementation of policies, programs and activities for the protection of Women and Children shall be used as input material for the formulation of policies, programs and activities for the protection of Women and Children victims of violence for the following year.

qa_issues: Meaning drift: "eksplotasi" in the original is translated as "exploitation"; it should be "exploitation" only if the source is "eksploitasi"—as written, the correct rendering is "explotation" (or keep the Indonesian term) to match the source text exactly for downstream evaluation.

text:
BAB XIII PEMBIAYAAN
Pasal 60
Pembiayaan penyelenggaraan Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak bersumber dari:
a. anggaran pendapatan dan belanja daerah; dan
b. sumber lain yang sah sesuai dengan ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan.
translated_text:
CHAPTER XIII FINANCING
Article 60
Financing for the implementation of Protection of Women and Children is sourced from:
a. regional revenue and expenditure budget; and
b. other legitimate sources in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

text:
Pasal 61
(1) Pemerintah Daerah dapat memberikan bantuan pembiayaan kepada organisasi masyarakat, organisasi sosial atau lembaga swadaya masyarakat yang melaksanakan Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak dari tindak kekerasan.
(2) Bantuan pembiayaan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1), sesuai dengan kemampuan keuangan daerah, dan dilaksanakan sesuai ketentuan peraturan perundang- undangan.
translated_text:
Article 61
(1) Regional Government may provide financial assistance to community organizations, social organizations or non-governmental organizations that implement Protection of Women and Children from acts of violence.
(2) Financial assistance as referred to in paragraph (1), shall be in accordance with regional financial capacity, and implemented in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

text:
BAB XIV SANKSI ADMINISTRATIF
Pasal 62
(1) Setiap orang atau Lembaga yang melaksanakan tugas pelayanan penanganan pengaduan korban kekerasan terhadap perempuan dan anak yang melanggar prinsip pelayanan sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 37 ayat (2) dikenakan sanksi administratif.
(2) Sanksi administratif sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) berupa:
a. teguran lisan;
b. teguran tertulis;
c. pencabutan izin sementara; atau
d. pencabutan izin.
(3) Pencabutan izin sementara sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (2) huruf c dilakukan setelah peringatan tertulis selama 3 (tiga) kali berturut-turut dengan tenggang waktu selama 7 (tujuh) hari kerja.
(4) Pencabutan izin sebagaimana dimaksud ayat (2) huruf c, dilakukan setelah pencabutan sementara dengan tenggang waktu selama 1 (satu) bulan.
translated_text:
CHAPTER XIV ADMINISTRATIVE SANCTIONS
Article 62
(1) Every person or Institution that carries out the task of providing complaint handling services for victims of violence against women and children who violates the service principles as referred to in Article 37 paragraph (2) shall be subject to administrative sanctions.
(2) Administrative sanctions as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be in the form of:
a. verbal warning;
b. written warning;
c. temporary revocation of license; or
d. revocation of license.
(3) Temporary revocation of license as referred to in paragraph (2) letter c shall be carried out after written warnings for 3 (three) consecutive times with a grace period of 7 (seven) working days.
(4) Revocation of license as referred to in paragraph (2) letter d, shall be carried out after temporary revocation with a grace period of 1 (one) month.
qa_issues: Meaning drift: Article 62(4) incorrectly references paragraph (2) letter c; the original refers to paragraph (2) letter d (revocation of license).

translated_text:
Article 63
Leaders of education units who violate the provisions as referred to in Article 24 paragraph (4) shall be subject to employment sanctions in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

KETENTUAN PERALIHAN
Pasal 64
Pada saat Peraturan Daerah ini mulai berlaku, P2TP2A yang telah ada tetap melaksanakan tugas dan fungsi pelayanan terpadu bagi perempuan dan anak sampai dibentuk P2TP2A berdasarkan Peraturan Daerah ini.
translated_text:
CHAPTER XV
TRANSITIONAL PROVISIONS
Article 64
At the time this Regional Regulation comes into force, the existing P2TP2A shall continue to carry out the duties and functions of integrated services for women and children until the P2TP2A is established based on this Regional Regulation.
